srList.sentence: To examine the relationship between work environment characteristics, such as transformational leadership, level of teamwork, job characteristics (independent variables) and staff-reported level of person-centred care (dependent variable), multilevel linear regression analyses (random intercept) were conducted, in which staff (level 1) was nested in nursing homes (level 2).
